continuous write speed up to 3,000MB/s 5-year Warranty Gives Peace of Mind Shorten Your Boot Time Significantly The AS2280P4U uses a M.2 PCIe Gen 3 x4 transmission interface, 3D flash memory, and Apacer's unique SSD tuning technology. Together, these greatly increase the read/write speed to 3,500/3,000 MB/s, improves data access capabilities, and allows users to boot quickly and easily switch between multiple programs, delivering an expert-level multi-tasking experience. The Ideal Choice for Professional Gamers and Creatives The 22mm x 80mm ultra-small body can accommodate storage of up to 2TB, but the thickness is only 2.25mm, which leaves precious space inside a computer case. The large storage capacity allows video editors or designers the freedom to display their creativity, and gives gamers room for the latest DLC. Stable Performance Well Into The Future To provide users with a flawless high-speed experience, the AS2280P4U SSD has built-in multiple protection technologies to effectively ensure data accuracy and stability. SLC Caching uses an advanced layered cache structure to improve the speed performance of the product. Global wear leveling technology and automatic error correction (ECC) functions can improve the average lifespan and operational stability of the SSD, making the AS2280P4U faster and more stable for years to come! 5-year Warranty Gives Peace of Mind The AS2280P4U has passed Apacer's rigorous product verification and has a five-year limited quality warranty, providing consumers with peace of mind.
